```tsx
// --- Component ---
"use client"
import * as React from "react"
import { gsap } from "gsap"
import { ScrollTrigger } from "gsap/ScrollTrigger"

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

export function SkylineCard({ title }: { title: string }) {
  const label = `Card ${title} keeps a \` backtick`;
  return <div className="skyline-card">{label}</div>;
}

export default SkylineCard;

// --- Demo ---
import { SkylineCard } from "@/components/ui/skyline-card"

export default function Demo() {
  return <SkylineCard title="Demo" />;
}
```
